changeHypothesis.summary: A-share turnover and risk appetite rebounded sharply and had already converted into January-February broker earnings, creating a real cyclical earnings inflection. The unresolved question is whether the earnings acceleration still exceeds the market rerating by late March.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Market activity can remain elevated for months but is reflexive and can normalize quickly; structural capital-market reform is a separate longer-horizon driver.

expectations.measurableGap: CITIC's March 30 report already forecast +52.6% 2019 profit growth and valued it near 1.9-2.0x PB, above the cited five-year mean; much of the earnings rebound is visible.
